HTML comment ending with ---> (three dashes) must not drop content that follows (issue #339)

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.android.*

fun main() {
    val result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<h1>One</h1>\n<!-- /// --->\n<p>Two</p>", ConversionOptions())
    println(result)
}
```
